decisionsTitle: «Doar Brașov Runners» shows the club for everyone who typed it, not only accounts on «Echipa»
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13**, an hour after §753 shipped, looking at the live race's «Cine vine» with «Clubul pe lista publică» = «Doar Brașov Runners»: «there is a bug on the club visibility settings … I don't see any club now». What he had asked for in §753: «I just want to show Brașov Runners members and ignore the other clubs because it's a free text people can type stupid stuff there, but I still want to show the BVR ones».

**The cause.** §753 showed the club's name only for a registration whose person had an account on «Echipa» (`memberCanonicalEmails`, the member bibs' test) **and** whose typed club named the club. The club's runners have no accounts on «Echipa» — adding the members there is still owed (CLAUDE.md «Still owed» item 18) — so nobody qualified, every cell was blank, and the column, drawn only when a row holds a value, disappeared.

**Decision.** Amends §753 §2. Under «Doar {club}» the cell holds the club's own name (`CLUB_NAME`) for **every** registration whose typed club names the club, whoever typed it; every other cell is blank, and the column is still not drawn when no row on the page holds a value. Membership is no condition: the query selects the typed club for every row and `memberClubCell` turns it into the club's name or into nothing in code, before the row is cached or drawn, so the typed text itself never reaches the cache or the page. This shows only what the person wrote, in the club's own spelling — the list showed every typed club before §753 — so nothing new is disclosed. No migration: the enum value `members_only` keeps its name and the label stays «Doar {club}». The editor's help says it in plain words and promises nothing about membership. Since the list no longer reads accounts, adding or removing one on «Echipa» no longer expires the public lists (§753's criterion 43 retires). The member bibs, the backoffice, the exports and the desk are untouched: membership for the bibs is still the account test.

**A more forgiving matcher**, still one tested function (`namesTheClub`). Case, diacritics, punctuation, spaces and filler words («Club», «Clubul», «Asociația», «Sportivă», «AS», «ACS», «CS», «Echipa», «Team») are folded away; what is left must split — glued or not — into pieces of the club's own vocabulary, derived from the configured name: its words (the last one singular too), their initials, the county's plate code standing for the first word («BV»), the nickname «BVR»; nothing else may be in the cell, and the pieces must name the club: the name's words in order («Brașov Runners», «BV Runners»), the initials beside the first word («BR Brașov», «Brașov BR»), or the nickname. One typo — a letter added, dropped, changed or two neighbours swapped, the first letter right, never a digit — is forgiven in each word of the name six letters or longer. So «Brașov Runners (BVR)», «BVR - Brasov Runners», «brasovrunners», «CLUB BRASOV RUNNERS», «Brasov Runners Team», «Brasov Runers» and «Brashov Runners» are the club; «Brașov Runners Cluj», «Runners Brașov Marathon Club Cluj», «Cluj Runners», «Brasov Gunners», «Brașov Running», «Runners» alone, «BR» alone and «Brașov» alone are not.

**Refused:**

- **Keeping the account test and asking the club to add its runners on «Echipa» first.** The race is live today and the owner asked for the club's name on the list, not for a membership register; a free-text club that names the club is what the person wrote.
- **Showing membership regardless of what was typed.** A member who typed nothing or another club still shows nothing: that would be a new disclosure (`AGENTS.md` §10.10).
- **Renaming the enum value.** `members_only` is a stored value; renaming it would be a migration for a word nobody reads.
- **A looser fuzzy match** (any word near the name, a substring). Another club's name that contains ours must stay another club.

Amends §753.
changelogLine: - **The public list's club shows for everyone who typed it** — under «Doar Brașov Runners» the list now writes «Brașov Runners» for every runner whose club names it, with or without an account on «Echipa», so the live race's list shows the club again; the matcher forgives «Brasov Runers», «BVR - Brasov Runners» and «brasovrunners», and still hides every other club. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Criteria 41 and 43 amended: under `members_only` the public list's club cell holds the club's own name for every registration whose typed club names the club, whoever typed it — an account on «Echipa» is no condition — and is blank for every other text; the typed text is turned into the club's name or into nothing before the row is cached or drawn, and adding or removing an account no longer expires the public lists (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A typed club names the club when, with case, diacritics, punctuation, spaces and filler words («Clubul», «Asociația», «ACS», «Team»…) folded, it splits — glued or not — into the club's own words, initials, plate-code short form and nicknames and nothing else, and names the club (its words in order, the initials beside the first word, or «BVR»); one typo is forgiven in each of its words of six letters or more; «Brașov Runners Cluj», «Cluj Runners», «Runners», «BR» and «Brașov» alone never match (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
